image_prompts.prompt: An exhausted Allosaurus collapsed at the base of a wooden victory stand. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Ochre-orange skin, chocolate-brown tiger stripes, and cream underbelly. ACTION: The dinosaur is completely 'melted' on the dirt track in a state of comical depletion. It is lying flat on its belly, legs splayed out sideways like noodles. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Its tongue is lolling out of the side of its mouth onto the dirt, eyes are rolling back in its head, and large 'sweat beads' are popping off its brow. It looks comically 'wiped out'. There is NO REFEREE OR OTHER CHARACTERS in the shot. SETTING: Next to a simple wooden 1st-2nd-3rd victory stand on a sunlit prehistoric track. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with rounded, toy-like forms and extreme physical comedy. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' centered, showing the full length of the collapsed dinosaur.
